scope: All DocumentIdentifier own value, path and content-selection operations using the existing bounded native helpers.
Five previously missing tabular signatures in the shared content detector.
oracle: The identifier literal and empty-file result come from DocumentIdentifier_test.cpp. The five tabular marker strings and branch precedence are transcribed from FileHandler.cpp:693-737. Additional path/resource/copy tests are independently specified native invariants. No expected result is generated by the production code and no C++ runtime execution is claimed.
native_boundaries: Complete record operation coverage does not certify exact FileHandler content-detection parity. The existing heuristic has a 64KiB/512-line cap, whitespace trimming, strict PNG magic, finite numeric checks and other documented differences.
Trimmed pepList and PSMS signatures accept additional indentation; input recognition remains separate from validation.
gzip/bzip2 require file-compression; ZIP remains unsupported.
Absolute paths are retained verbatim; relative paths resolve against process cwd without canonicalization. UTF-8,1MiB and NUL checks preserve previous fields on failure.
FeatureMap and MSExperiment aggregate migration is separate.
